name: SASV Challenge 2022
description: ASV (automatic speaker verification) systems are intrinsically required to reject both non-target (e.g., voice uttered by different speaker) and spoofed (e.g., synthesised or converted) inputs. However, there is little consideration for how ASV systems themselves should be adapted when they are expected to encounter spoofing attacks, nor when they operate in tandem with CMs (spoofing countermeasures), much less how both systems should be jointly optimised. The goal of the first SASV (spoofing-aware speaker verification) challenge, a special sesscion in ISCA INTERSPEECH 2022, is to promote development of integrated systems that can perform ASV and CM simultaneously.
evaluation_method: equal error rate and tandem detection cost function
typical_sota_score: 0.5%–5% (EER range) depending on system and dataset split
reputation: A recognized challenge benchmark in the speaker verification community, especially for spoofing-aware and integrated ASV/CM systems.
notes: Challenge-style benchmark with multiple subsystems and operating points; results are often reported separately for ASV, CM, and joint SASV performance.
